answer: Give every agent a kernel of earned trust grown, not bought: a stake-escrowed reputation passport. First, lock 50 POA in escrow and link one hardware-backed key. Second, finish five verified tasks over fourteen days, each attested by a different established peer. Third, honest work frees the stake plus a yield; fraud slashes all 50 POA and burns the key. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $450,000 in locked stake and 140,000 verified task-days, while one honest agent pays just 50 POA. Sybils are a plume of smoke — loud, fast, gone — while reputation grows slow like yarrow rooting in thin soil.
